basics.name: Yijiahao (Friedrich) Qi
basics.summary: First-year Ph.D. student in ECE at Cornell University working on efficient and scalable systems for machine learning, with an emphasis on distributed training and inference.

education.area: Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering

publications.name: CREATE: Cross-Layer Resilience Characterization and Optimization for Efficient yet Reliable Embodied AI Systems
publications.summary: Characterizes the reliability of LLM-based embodied AI systems at the application, system, and circuit levels, and proposes error detection and correction techniques for efficient yet reliable embodied AI. (Co-first author.)

publications.name: Faster-MoA: Low-Latency Tree-Structured MoA Serving with Early Exit and Agent-Aware Prefill-Decode Overlap
publications.summary: Accelerates Mixture-of-Agents serving with a tree-structured aggregation architecture, semantic-similarity-based early exit, and agent-aware prefill-decode overlap. (Co-first author.)

publications.name: DySL-VLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference via Dynamic-Static Layer-Skipping for Robot Manipulation
publications.summary: Adaptive layer-skipping for VLA model inference based on task requirements and motion significance, cutting trainable parameters by 85.7× versus full fine-tuning.
